In Re: CAN 11032 of 2017 (not in the list) This application is treated in the day's list.

This is an application for stay of operation of the impugned judgment and award dated 30th August, 2017 passed by learned Additional District Judge-cum- Judge, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, 4th Court, Barasat, 24 Parganas (North) in MAC Case No. 29 of 2008 under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act.

entities.text: Additional District Judge-cum- Judge, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, 4th Court, Barasat, 24 Parganas (North)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
By the order dated 30th August, 2017, the learned Tribunal granted compensation of Rs. 3,01,500/-
in favour of the claimants together with interest under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act.

Mr. Alam, learned advocate for the appellant- insurance company submits that the insurance company has already deposited the statutory amount and is ready and willing to deposit the entire awarded sum together with interest less statutory deposit before the learned Registrar General,
High Court, Calcutta within such period as would be directed by this Court.
On such count, he prays for stay of operation of impugned Judgment and award.

The office report dated 19th December, 2017 shows deposit of statutory amount of Rs. 25,000/-
before the registry of this Court in terms of Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act vide OD challan No. 2009 dated 21st November, 2017.

In view of readiness and willingness on the part of the appellant-insurance company to deposit entire awarded sum together with interest less statutory deposit, there shall be stay of the impugned judgment an award for a period of four weeks.

The appellant- Insurance Company is directed to deposit the entire awarded sum together with interest less statutory deposit before the learned Registrar General, High Court, Calcutta within a period of four weeks from date.

sentences.text: 2 In the event, the appellant-insurance company makes deposit of the aforesaid amount, the stay shall continue till the disposal of this application.
In default to make deposit of the aforesaid amount the stay shall stand vacated without reference to this Court.

Learned Registrar General shall ensure that the amount to be deposited by the appellant-Insurance Company be invested in the short term auto renewable scheme of any nationalized bank until further orders.
The appellant-insurance company is directed to serve a copy of the application upon respondents and file affidavit-of-service on the returnable date.
Let the matter appear on 15th September, 2023 under the heading "Application".

(Bivas Pattanayak, J.)
